hero.title: Patent Timeline: From Foundations to LLM Era
hero.subtitle: key Google search patents spanning 2000-2026. From HITS (2000) and PageRank (2001) through Panda, Hummingbird, RankBrain, and Word2Vec to the LLM era. Pre-2023 patents establish authority, entity, quality, and feedback systems. Modern patents (2023+) show a rapid shift to LLM-based ranking, RL fine-tuning, and AI-generated content.

keyInsight.label: Key Pattern: From Hand-Crafted to LLM-Based
keyInsight.text: The pre-2023 era reveals three architectural layers: link-based authority (PageRank 2001, Reasonable Surfer 2010, Distance-Based PageRank 2018), content quality (Phrase-Based Indexing 2009, Panda 2014, Hummingbird 2013), and user signals (Click Feedback 2015, Word2Vec/RankBrain 2017). The DOJ trial confirmed most signals are hand-crafted, not ML. But 2023+ patents show a rapid shift: US20250124067A1 uses LLMs for pairwise ranking, US20260010575A1 fine-tunes LLMs with RL, and US12536233B1 generates AI landing pages. The hand-crafted era is transitioning to a fully LLM-augmented pipeline.

patents.title: HITS Algorithm (Connectivity Analysis)
patents.desc: Ranks documents as hubs and authorities using connectivity analysis. Pages linking to authorities become hubs. Kleinberg algorithm.

patents.title: PageRank
patents.desc: THE foundational patent. Ranks documents by analyzing hyperlink structure, assigning importance based on number and quality of incoming links.

patents.title: Local Inter-Connectivity Reranking
patents.desc: Reranks search results by analyzing link connections between top results. Pages linking to each other form authority clusters.

patents.title: Detecting Query-Specific Duplicate Documents
patents.desc: Detects near-duplicate pages per query. Ensures search results show diverse content, not copies of the same page.

patents.title: Detecting Duplicate and Near-Duplicate Files
patents.desc: Fingerprint-based duplicate detection using shingling. Identifies copied content across the web at scale.

patents.title: Information Extraction from a Database
patents.desc: Sergey Brin's DIPRE system. Extracts structured information from the web using pattern matching. Foundation for Knowledge Graph.

patents.title: Scoring Documents in a Linked Database
patents.desc: PageRank continuation. Weighted link scoring with damping factor improvements. Larry Page's refined ranking method.

patents.title: Method for Node Ranking in a Linked Database
patents.desc: Further PageRank refinement. Handles link spam and dangling nodes. Assigns initial scores based on document features.

patents.title: Ranking Documents Based on Large Data Sets
patents.desc: Large-scale document ranking using distributed computing. Handles billions of documents across server clusters.

patents.title: Personalizing Anchor Text Scores
patents.desc: Personalizes link value by adjusting anchor text scores based on user profiles, search history, and preferences.

patents.title: Identifying Manipulated Articles
patents.desc: Detects content manipulation by comparing article versions over time. Identifies suspicious edits and content spinning.

patents.title: Anchor Tag Indexing in Web Crawler
patents.desc: Indexes anchor text during crawling. Associates anchor descriptions with target pages for ranking signals.

patents.title: Editorial Opinion in Search Ranking
patents.desc: Combines algorithmic ranking with editorial/human evaluations. Curated ratings influence search result ordering.

patents.title: Search Results for Ambiguous Queries
patents.desc: Handles ambiguous queries by providing diverse results covering multiple interpretations. Query disambiguation.

patents.title: Link-Based Clustering of Hyperlinked Documents
patents.desc: Clusters web pages by link structure. Pages that link to each other or share link neighborhoods form topical clusters.

patents.title: Semantic Units from Search Queries
patents.desc: Identifies semantic units (meaningful phrases, entities) within search queries. Foundation for understanding multi-word queries.

patents.title: Scoring Documents in a Linked Database
patents.desc: Advanced link-based scoring with spam resistance. Analyzes link graph topology to identify authoritative documents.

patents.title: Large Scale Machine Learning Systems
patents.desc: Infrastructure for large-scale ML in search. Distributed learning across massive document collections.

patents.title: Anchor Text as Parallel Corpora
patents.desc: Uses anchor text as parallel translations for cross-language information retrieval. Links bridge language barriers.

patents.title: Information Retrieval Based on Historical Data
patents.desc: Scores documents using temporal data: discovery date, change frequency, link acquisition patterns, user behavior over time.

patents.title: Automatically Creating Lists
patents.desc: Automatically generates structured lists from web content. Foundation for featured snippet list extraction.

patents.title: Automatic Taxonomy Generation Using Phrases
patents.desc: Generates topic taxonomies from phrase co-occurrence patterns. Organizes search results into meaningful categories.

patents.title: Phrase-Based Indexing
patents.desc: Uses co-occurring phrases to index and retrieve documents. Phrases that predict other phrases indicate topical relevance.

patents.title: Query Rewriting with Entity Detection
patents.desc: Detects named entities in queries and rewrites queries to improve results. Foundation for brand/entity understanding.

patents.title: Improving Ranking of News Articles
patents.desc: Ranks news by source reputation, publication recency, and topical relevance. Foundation for Google News ranking.

patents.title: Query Term Synonyms Within Query Context
patents.desc: Determines synonyms contextually. Same word has different synonyms depending on query context and user intent.

patents.title: Finding Related Hyperlinked Documents
patents.desc: Discovers related pages by analyzing link graph neighborhoods. Pages sharing similar link patterns are topically related.

patents.title: Agent Rank
patents.desc: Assigns quality scores based on author reputation via digital signatures. Foundation for E-E-A-T author signals.

patents.title: Search Result Ranking Based on Trust
patents.desc: Ranks results based on trust scores from expert annotations. Trust propagation from seed documents through links.

patents.title: Reasonable Surfer Model
patents.desc: Links users are likely to click pass more PageRank. Considers link position, font size, anchor text, content relatedness.

patents.title: Ranking Search Results Using Language Types
patents.desc: Adjusts ranking based on language comparison between document and query. Language type matching.

patents.title: Content Author Badges
patents.desc: Visual verification of content creators via cryptographic hash. Design elements for authorship representation.

patents.title: Reputation of an Author of Online Content
patents.desc: Author reputation scoring based on peer reviews and community ratings. Scores affect content ranking and revenue.

patents.title: Rank-Modifying Spammers
patents.desc: Anti-spam mechanism using rank transition functions. Temporarily changes rankings to break spammer feedback loops.

patents.title: Scoring Documents by Co-Occurrence
patents.desc: Scores documents using word co-occurrence relationships. Enables ranking pages with no hyperlink connections between them.

patents.title: Synonym Identification (Hummingbird)
patents.desc: Identifies synonyms via co-occurring non-adjacent query terms. Foundation for Hummingbird semantic search capabilities.

patents.title: Ranking Based on Reference Contexts
patents.desc: Analyzes text surrounding links to detect paid links and link spam. Rare words near links create context identifiers.

patents.title: Using Resource Load Times in Ranking
patents.desc: Page load time as ranking factor. Faster-loading pages promoted when relevance is similar. Measures across devices and regions.

patents.title: Document Scoring Based on Inception Date
patents.desc: Scores documents based on when first discovered by search engine. Newer documents can receive freshness boost.

patents.title: Classifying Web Blocks by Linguistic Features
patents.desc: Identifies page sections (nav, content, ads, boilerplate) using linguistic features. Extracts main content for ranking.

patents.title: Index Server Architecture with Phrase Posting Lists
patents.desc: Tiered and sharded phrase posting lists for search infrastructure. Enables fast phrase-level lookups at scale.

patents.title: Document Treadmilling
patents.desc: System for updating documents in repository and recovering storage from invalidated documents. Keeps index fresh.

patents.title: Detecting Spam via Phrase-Based Indexing
patents.desc: Uses phrase-based analysis to detect spam. Documents with unnatural phrase patterns flagged as low quality.

patents.title: Characterizing Documents by Clusters of Related Words
patents.desc: Groups related words into clusters to characterize document topics. Foundation for topical relevance assessment.

patents.title: Preferred Country Biasing of Search Results
patents.desc: Biases search results based on geographic location. Promotes content relevant to user country and language.

patents.title: Interface for a Universal Search Engine
patents.desc: Unified interface combining web, image, news, and other search verticals. Foundation for Universal Search.

patents.title: Specialized Results for Patterned Queries
patents.desc: Generates specialized search results (weather, stocks, definitions) when query matches known patterns.

patents.title: Learning Objects and Facts from Documents
patents.desc: Extracts entities and facts from document patterns. Foundation for automated Knowledge Graph population.

patents.title: Learning Synonymous Object Names from Anchors
patents.desc: Discovers entity synonyms from anchor text patterns. Foundation for entity resolution and disambiguation.

patents.title: Ranking Search Results (Panda)
patents.desc: Named after co-inventor Navneet Panda. Uses independent link counts and reference queries to modify ranking scores.

patents.title: Implicit User Feedback with Presentation Bias
patents.desc: Click feedback ranking with position bias correction. Users tend to click higher results regardless of relevance.

patents.title: Identifying Central Entities
patents.desc: Identifies main entity of a web page via entity graphs and centrality scoring. Distinguishes primary topic from secondary mentions.

patents.title: Site Quality Score
patents.desc: Site quality from ratio of branded navigational queries to total queries. Directly measures user demand for a site.

patents.title: Click-Through Temporal Feedback
patents.desc: Adjusts rankings by temporal weighting of clicks. Recent clicks count more. Activates after threshold of selections.

patents.title: Detecting Keyword-Stuffed Business Titles
patents.desc: Detects businesses stuffing keywords into their names for local SEO. Compares titles against expected naming patterns.

patents.title: Confirming Authorship of Documents
patents.desc: Entity verification via profile links and email authentication. Authorship confirmation system.

patents.title: Ranking by User Behavior and Feature Data
patents.desc: Updated Reasonable Surfer model. Combines user click behavior with page feature data for link weight assignment.

patents.title: Sentence Compression for Snippets
patents.desc: Automated sentence compression using dependency trees. Foundation for generating concise featured snippet answers.

patents.title: Reverse Engineering Spam Detection Circumvention
patents.desc: Detects when spammers reverse-engineer anti-spam algorithms. Identifies patterns of systematic testing and adaptation.

patents.title: User-Context-Based Search Engine
patents.desc: Assigns macro/micro context vectors to queries. Searches matching closest context. Foundation for personalized neural search.

patents.title: Location Quality Based on Travel Time
patents.desc: Scores physical locations by analyzing how much time users invest traveling there. High travel investment signals quality.

patents.title: Obtaining Authoritative Search Results
patents.desc: Identifies authoritative results by combining content signals with entity recognition. Authority verification system.

patents.title: Extracting Facts from Documents
patents.desc: Automated fact extraction from unstructured text. Populates Knowledge Graph with verified factual claims.

patents.title: Searching Quotes of Entities
patents.desc: Indexes and retrieves direct quotes attributed to entities. Enables searching for what people/organizations said.

patents.title: Word2Vec (Computing Word Vectors)
patents.desc: Maps words into high-dimensional vector space. Semantically similar words cluster together. Foundation for RankBrain.

patents.title: Predicting Site Quality
patents.desc: Uses n-gram phrase models to predict quality scores for new sites. Applies Panda-style assessment without behavioral data.

patents.title: Subjective Attributes via Curation Signals
patents.desc: Identifies subjective entity attributes from user-generated content. Tags entities with crowd opinions.

patents.title: Watch Time Based Ranking
patents.desc: Ranks content by watch/engagement time rather than clicks alone. Longer engagement signals higher quality content.

patents.title: Scoring Candidate Answer Passages
patents.desc: Scores passages from structured and unstructured data using query term match and query-independent signals.

patents.title: Distance-Based PageRank
patents.desc: Updated PageRank using shortest distances from seed pages in link graph. Replaces iterative random-walk with distance model.

patents.title: Efficient Index for Large Graphs
patents.desc: Two-dimensional index for Knowledge Graph search at trillion-edge scale. Low-latency entity lookup.

patents.title: Related Entities
patents.desc: Identifies related entities via co-occurrence, shared attributes, and authoritative sources. Knowledge Graph linking.

patents.title: Website Representation Vector
patents.desc: Neural network classifies sites as expert, apprentice, or layperson within knowledge domains. E-E-A-T foundation.

patents.title: Triggering Knowledge Panels
patents.desc: Determines when to display knowledge panels. Identifies factual entities, selects primary entity, decides panel display.

patents.title: Generating Author Vectors
patents.desc: Neural networks generate author-characterizing vectors from writing style. Identifies authors without explicit markup.

patents.title: Modifying Search Result Ranking Based on Implicit User Feedback
patents.desc: Ranks using viewing duration metrics and LC|C click fraction. Weights clicks by dwell time, adapts by query type.

patents.title: Presenting Search Result Information
patents.desc: Ranks pages referenced in web notebooks. Crowdsourced curation signals boost referenced pages.

patents.title: Using User Input to Adapt Search Results
patents.desc: Dynamic search adaptation through conversational interaction across devices during sessions.

patents.title: Evaluating Output Sequences Using Auto-Regressive LM
patents.desc: Single auto-regressive LM for generation and quality evaluation. Rates sensibleness, specificity, interestingness.

patents.title: Evaluating an Interpretation for a Search Query
patents.desc: Two-stage ML: BERT-based accuracy assessment + logistic regression with temporal patterns and clustering.

patents.title: Text Ranking with Pairwise Ranking Prompting
patents.desc: LLM-based pairwise document comparison for ranking. Reduces complexity vs pointwise scoring.

patents.title: Multi Source Extraction and Scoring of Short Query Answers
patents.desc: Featured snippet quality via multi-source consensus scoring. Only displays if accuracy exceeds threshold.

patents.title: Document Activity Logs to Train ML Models for Relevance
patents.desc: Trains relevance models using co-access patterns instead of clicks. K-anonymization for privacy.

patents.title: Search Results Based on Compositional Queries
patents.desc: Handles multi-entity queries with spatial/temporal relationships via KG lookup tables.

patents.title: Providing Knowledge Panels with Search Results
patents.desc: Knowledge panels from multi-source aggregation. Ranks panel content by historical search frequency.

patents.title: Contextualizing Knowledge Panels
patents.desc: Dynamic KG panel customization based on query context terms. Same entity, different presentations.

patents.title: Parsing Natural Language Queries Without Retraining
patents.desc: Resolves query ambiguity through user interaction. Retains domain terms without model retraining.

patents.title: Identification and Issuance of Repeatable Queries
patents.desc: ML-based detection of recurring queries. Pre-indexes and caches results for temporal patterns.

patents.title: Generative Summaries for Search Results
patents.desc: AI summaries with freshness measures, locality, language, and user expertise adaptation.

patents.title: Thematic Search
patents.desc: LLM-based thematic clustering of search results. Ranks themes by document prominence.

patents.title: Search with Stateful Chat
patents.desc: Conversational search maintaining user state. Generates synthetic queries, selects downstream LLMs.

patents.title: Presenting Search Results (Content Safety)
patents.desc: Content rating score from mature/family-friendly classification. ML-based query safety filtering.

patents.title: Search Result Filters from Resource Content
patents.desc: Dynamic filter generation from search result content analysis. Extracts keywords, removes duplicates.

patents.title: Combining Parameters of Multiple Search Queries
patents.desc: Detects semantic similarity between sequential queries. Combines into enhanced searches via embeddings.

patents.title: Query Categorization Based on Image Results
patents.desc: Categorizes queries by analyzing user interactions with image results via computer vision.

patents.title: Information Retrieval Using Multivariate Distributions
patents.desc: Represents queries/docs as probability distributions (mean + variance). Captures query ambiguity and topic breadth via KL divergence.

patents.title: Cross-List Learning to Rank
patents.desc: Training ranking models using pairs from different lists. Computes cross-query correlation to weight pairwise ranking losses.

patents.title: Contextualized Token Retriever
patents.desc: Retrieval using only retrieved token vectors, not all tokens. 4000x computational reduction on BEIR benchmarks.

patents.title: Reranking Documents Based on Graph Representations
patents.desc: Reranks using Abstract Meaning Representation graphs. Combines semantic graph structure with inter-document connections.

patents.title: Independent Content Hosting System
patents.desc: Ranks UGC using creator reputation, engagement signals, and LLM-evaluated language quality. Content gets unique indexable URLs.

patents.title: Query-Aware Extractive Hierarchical Summarization
patents.desc: Scores sentence relevance to queries hierarchically. 3-5ms per document, scalable to billions of queries. Used for re-ranking.

patents.title: Utilizing LLM in Responding to Multifaceted Queries
patents.desc: Decomposes complex multi-part queries into subqueries. Filters, searches each facet, synthesizes comprehensive responses.

patents.title: AI-Generated Content Page Tailored to a Specific User
patents.desc: Landing page quality score from conversion rates, bounce rates, CTR, content quality. Generates AI alternatives when scores are low.

patents.title: Predictive Generation of Search Suggestions
patents.desc: Location-based predictive ranking using device location, query logs, user selection frequency, and social graph data.

patents.title: Fine-Tuning LLMs Using RL with Search Engine Feedback
patents.desc: Fine-tunes LLMs using search results as supervision. Trains reward models via RL, distills search knowledge into primary LLM.

patents.title: Techniques for Presenting Graphical Content in Search
patents.desc: Verifies organization images via ML + real-time entity database. Prevents imposter content in SERPs through dual verification.

patents.title: Mapping Images to Search Queries
patents.desc: Converts image queries to text via knowledge graph entity extraction. Scores candidate queries by relevance, user intent, and popularity.

patents.title: Privacy-Sensitive Training of Interaction Prediction
patents.desc: Federated learning trains click prediction models on user devices. Only parameter updates sent centrally, not raw interaction data.

patents.title: Query Response Using a Custom Corpus
patents.desc: LLMs generate API calls to external document collections, retrieve results, and condition responses. RAG for search without model retraining.

patents.title: Privacy-Preserving Personalized LLMs
patents.desc: Personalizes LLM responses via soft prompt embeddings from user features (age, location). Groups users or predicts custom embeddings.

patents.title: Instruction Fine-Tuning with Intermediate Reasoning
patents.desc: Chain-of-thought fine-tuning with annotator reasoning traces. Less than 5% reasoning data improves model generalization substantially.

patents.title: Unifying Transformers with Link Based Ranking
patents.desc: Injects PageRank and authority signals into transformer attention weights. Boosts tokens from high-authority sources, reduces hallucinations.

patents.title: Searchable Index from ML Model Outputs
patents.desc: Converts ML predictions into token-based searchable indices. Eliminates two-stage retrieval+ranking by embedding ML intelligence in the index.

patents.title: Data Extraction Using LLMs
patents.desc: Treats entire websites as LLM input to generate entity characterizations. Builds hierarchical knowledge graphs without structured markup.

patents.title: Hybrid Retrieval and Generative System
patents.desc: Routes query portions to retrieval or generative systems in parallel. Retrieval can short-circuit generation if strong matches found.

patents.title: Generative Model Tuning with Quality Signals
patents.desc: Uses search ranking signals to train generative models. Higher-ranked content gets more training emphasis. ML reward model scores outputs.

patents.title: Detecting Signal Exploitation in Rankings
patents.desc: Detects ranking signal manipulation via residual analysis. Uses regression models and Z-scores across domains, caps inflated signals.

patents.title: Generating Query Variants Using a Trained Generative Model
patents.desc: Neural generative model creates query variants at runtime for PAA, PASF features. Handles novel and tail queries without retraining.

patents.title: Embedding Based Retrieval for Image Search
patents.desc: Maps queries and image-landing page pairs to shared embedding space via neural networks. Combines with term-based retrieval.

patents.title: Combining Content with a Search Result
patents.desc: Enriches search results with supplementary content from knowledge sources. Merges entity data directly into result snippets.

patents.title: Ranking Based on Media Consumption History
patents.desc: Uses media viewing history and consumption patterns to personalize search results. Weighs engagement duration and frequency.

patents.title: Detecting a Homoglyph in a String of Characters
patents.desc: Identifies homoglyph substitutions in URLs and content to detect phishing and spam. Alerts users to deceptive character replacements.

patents.title: Automatic Content Item Updation
patents.desc: Generates content updates automatically from computer-mediated interactions. Detects stale content and produces refresh candidates.

patents.title: Contextual Estimation of Link Information Gain
patents.desc: Estimates information gain from links based on source and target context. Rewards pages providing novel information beyond the linking page.

patents.title: Generating Query Answers from User History
patents.desc: Searches user's browsing history and email for previously accessed content. NLP classifies re-finding queries and fuzzy-matches past pages.

patents.title: Increasing Query-Answering Agent Accuracy
patents.desc: Multi-agent QA system generating consultation prompts, retrieving responses, and evaluating against accuracy thresholds before answering.

patents.title: Identifying Search Results in History Repository
patents.desc: Tracks and indexes user search result interactions over time. Surfaces previously visited results when re-finding intent detected.

patents.title: Content Snippet Generation with Generative Model
patents.desc: Uses generative models to create search result snippets. Groups content segments for coherent multi-source summaries.

patents.title: Prompt-Based Query Generation for Diverse Retrieval
patents.desc: PROMPTAGATOR: LLMs generate synthetic training data for dual encoders. Creates task-specific retrievers overcoming data scarcity.

patents.title: User Embedding Models for Personalization
patents.desc: Compresses user history into embeddings via transformer model. Provides soft prompts to LLMs for personalized search responses.

calculations.name: US20250124067A1 Pairwise Ranking
calculations.how: LLM-based pairwise document comparison for ranking. Instead of scoring each document independently (pointwise), the model compares two documents at a time to determine which is more relevant. Reduces complexity vs pointwise scoring. Signals shift from individual features to full-document understanding.
calculations.formula: PairwiseRank(d1, d2, q) = LLM( "Which is more relevant to q: d1 or d2?" ) → {d1 | d2} // O(n log n) comparisons vs O(n) pointwise // full-document understanding, not features
calculations.affects: Affected by: LLM model capacity, document pair selection, comparison prompt design, training data quality

calculations.name: US20260010575A1 RL Fine-tuning
calculations.how: Fine-tunes LLMs using search results as supervision signal. Trains reward models via reinforcement learning where search engagement data provides the reward signal. The search engine itself becomes the training ground for the ranking model.
calculations.formula: RL_finetune(LLM) = train( reward_model(search_engagement), distill(search_knowledge) → LLM ) // search engine = training ground // RL reward from user engagement data
calculations.affects: Affected by: search engagement data, reward model accuracy, RL training stability, search feedback loop quality

calculations.name: US12536233B1 AI Landing Pages
calculations.how: Landing page quality score derived from conversion rates, bounce rates, and CTR. When scores fall below threshold, the system generates AI alternative landing pages. Google may replace publisher pages with AI-generated versions optimized for user satisfaction.
calculations.formula: PageQuality(url) = score( conversion_rate, bounce_rate, CTR ) if score < threshold: generate AI_alternative // Google may replace your page with AI version
calculations.affects: Affected by: conversion rate, bounce rate, CTR, user satisfaction metrics, page quality threshold

calculations.name: US20250103662A1 PageRank in Transformers
calculations.how: Injects PageRank and authority signals directly into transformer attention weights. Bridges classic link-based authority with neural ranking by making the transformer architecture natively aware of graph-based trust signals during inference.
calculations.formula: Attention(Q, K, V) += inject( PageRank(source), authority(source) ) // boosts tokens from high-authority sources // bridges link-based trust + neural ranking // reduces hallucinations via authority grounding
calculations.affects: Affected by: PageRank scores, transformer attention mechanism, authority signal injection method, model architecture

stages.detail: PageRank, Panda, Hummingbird, Word2Vec/RankBrain, hand-crafted signals
BERT evaluation, knowledge panels, click refinement
Stateful chat, thematic clustering, distribution-based retrieval
LLM pairwise ranking, 4000x-efficient retrieval, graph reranking
RL fine-tuning from search feedback, AI-generated landing pages

contradictions.publicClaim: "Only RankBrain and DeepRank use ML. All other signals are hand-crafted." (HJ Kim deposition)
contradictions.internalClaim: US20250124067A1 uses LLMs for pairwise ranking. US20260010575A1 fine-tunes LLMs via RL with search engine feedback. LLMs are replacing hand-crafted signals.

contradictions.publicClaim: Search is a stateless query-response system. Each query is independent.
contradictions.internalClaim: US20240289407A1 introduces stateful conversational search maintaining context across interactions. Search becomes a dialogue.

contradictions.publicClaim: Optimize landing pages manually. Google crawls and indexes what you publish.
contradictions.internalClaim: US12536233B1 scores landing page quality (conversion, bounce, CTR) and generates AI alternatives when scores are low. Google may replace your page.

contradictions.publicClaim: Click signals feed into NavBoost as aggregated statistics in a "big table."
contradictions.internalClaim: US11816114B1 introduces sophisticated click weighting: LC|C fractions, query-type adaptation, and presentation bias correction.
